explanation: The theorem computes the primitive part of the binary norm form of the library's own hyperbolic plane lattice. It depends on the library's own definitions: BinaryQuadraticForm, primPart, hyperbolicPlane and binaryNormForm. I grepped Mathlib for primPart and hyperbolicPlane. The only hits were the polynomial primPart in GaussLemma, Content and Luroth, which are unrelated. Mathlib has no binary quadratic form primPart and no lattice hyperbolic plane example, so there is no matching declaration.
